    - NO MATCH - Missing: ESG/environmental platform, facility emissions tracking, supplier emissions data, carbon accounting, net-zero commitment monitoring

    - MATCH: sap.sf:agent:SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1

    - NO MATCH - Missing: Document parsing/OCR, PDF text extraction, NLP for contract analysis
    - Landscape has contract validation/matching agents but NO document extraction/parsing capabilities

17. Compare extracted commercial terms across vendor contracts for inconsistencies (renewal, consolidation decisions):
    - NO MATCH - Missing: Contract term comparison engine, inconsistency detection, cross-contract analysis
    - Landscape has invoice reconciliation (VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation) but NO proactive contract term comparison capability

18. Lease modification adjustment reconciliation to IFRS 16 journal entries:
    - NO MATCH - Missing: Lease accounting reconciliation, IFRS 16 liability/ROU asset tracking
    - SAP S4 has AssetLifecycleChangeOrchestrator (general asset lifecycle) but NOT lease-specific accounting
    - SAP Ariba has invoice reconciliation but NOT lease accounting
    - Landscape lacks lease modification/journal entry reconciliation capability

19. Automated data integration pipeline consolidating sustainability data from ERP/HR/facility mgmt:
    - NO MATCH - Missing: ETL/data pipeline orchestration, multi-system data consolidation, staging area management
    - Landscape has business process automation (agents) and domain-specific API retrieval
    - No capability for cross-system data aggregation or sustainability data consolidation
